description: Connect a domain the person already owns to one of their sites (Pro plan). Returns the DNS records they must create at their domain provider. The domain starts serving once those records are in place and the certificate is issued, usually within minutes; use check_domain to follow it.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. "www.example.com". International names in punycode (xn--…).

site.description: The site that should answer on this domain.

name: add_domain
